experienceHighlights.text: Decided and executed release of each report version, ensuring alignment with treasury desk needs.
experienceHighlights.witness: I decided and executed the release of each report version to the desks

experienceHighlights.text: Built and maintained reporting data models in SQL Server and SSAS, and developed Power BI report layer for intraday cash positions and liquidity ratios.
experienceHighlights.witness: Built and maintained the reporting data models (SQL Server, SSAS) and the report layer (Power BI) for intraday cash positions and liquidity ratios.

experienceHighlights.text: Led monthly reporting change board with desk heads, recording decisions in minutes.
experienceHighlights.witness: Led the monthly reporting change board with the desk heads, deciding which change requests were scheduled and recording the decisions in the change-board minutes.

experienceHighlights.text: Coordinated data‑source changes with platform team, documenting ownership boundaries.
experienceHighlights.witness: Coordinated data-source changes with the platform team through the platform change process, recording that the platform team owned the source feeds while I owned the reporting models and releases.
